name: Belief Propagation Expansion Inventory
description: Declarative refinement inventory for belief propagation pipelines.

operations.name: Insert Message Convergence Monitoring
operations.dejargonized_summary: Monitor whether factor-to-variable messages are still changing too much.

rewrite.before_summary: Factor-to-variable messages feed downstream belief updates without convergence evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A message-convergence monitor is inserted after factor-to-variable message computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds convergence evidence before downstream belief updates consume messages.

operations.name: Insert Belief Normalization Validation
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check that marginal beliefs normalize to valid probability distributions.

rewrite.before_summary: Marginal beliefs flow downstream without explicit normalization evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A normalization validator is inserted after marginal belief computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds probability-validity evidence for marginal beliefs.

operations.name: Insert Message Damping Analysis
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether message damping is needed to stabilize loopy updates.

rewrite.before_summary: Variable-to-factor messages continue without oscillation evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A damping analysis stage is inserted after variable-to-factor message computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds stability evidence for loopy message passing.

operations.name: Insert Cycle Detection
operations.dejargonized_summary: Detect graph cycles that make exact tree-style belief propagation unsafe.

rewrite.before_summary: Variable-to-factor messages may assume tree-like structure implicitly.
rewrite.after_summary: A cycle detector is inserted before variable-to-factor message computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds graph-structure evidence before approximate loopy updates.

audit.rationale: Moves existing belief propagation expansion rules onto the common provider expansion schema.
audit.dejargonized_summary: Reusable checks for message convergence, normalization, damping, and cycles.
